test.notes: BUILD SUCCESSFUL - 24 tasks executed, 960 tests total (0 failures, 0 errors, 2 skipped). One informational note about unchecked operations in sdk-core (not an error).

typecheck.notes: Java compilation (compileJava + compileTestJava) passed for all modules: sdk-core, sdk-native, sdk-engine, sdk-cli. No compilation errors.

lint.notes: No separate lint tool configured. Gradle build includes compilation warnings check. No encoding/unmappable character warnings. One 'unchecked or unsafe operations' note (informational, not a lint failure).

nonBlockingIssues.description: ProcessBuilder.waitFor() has no timeout parameter when checking cmake --version. Could hang indefinitely in edge case.
Else-branch log message says 'cmake not found on PATH' but after commit 9ec76d7, the check also fails when feagiFfiIncludeDir doesn't exist. Message is slightly misleading.
equals() tests only cover one inequality case (type differs). Missing: equals(null), equals(different-type), and inequality tests for each individual field.
No test for NaN range values in MotorUnitConfig, though the constructor validates against NaN.
VisionUnitConfig now has hardcoded builder defaults (modality='camera', width=640, height=480), which conflicts with CLAUDE.md's 'No hardcoded defaults' convention.
Else-branch log message says 'cmake not found on PATH' but doesn't mention the FFI directory existence check. Misleading when cmake is available but FFI dir is missing.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Remove the outdated TODO-style note in Testing & Validation Guidance: 'The sdk-native `build` task has a `dependsOn("cmakeBuild")` hook that will fail without cmake — this must be made conditional'. This is now resolved. Replace with: 'The sdk-native cmake build hook is conditional — cmake tasks only run when both cmake is on PATH and the feagi-java-ffi include directory exists.'
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Features fix-gradle-cmake-hook (cc75f4e) and verify-full-green-build (9ec76d7) implemented the conditional. Two reviewers flagged the outdated AGENTS.md note.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add convention note: 'When fixing test compilation errors, be aware that compileTestJava compiles ALL test files in a module together. A worker may need to fix test files outside its feature scope to pass compilation. If doing so, document this in the handoff and note which other features' work was completed.'
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: fix-motor-unit-config-tests worker (e8be614) had to fix 4 additional test files (AgentCapabilitiesUnitSupportTest, BaseAgentTest, FeagiClientConfigTest, ZmqTransportTest) beyond its scope to pass compileTestJava. This made 3 subsequent features (fix-capabilities-unit-support-tests, fix-constructor-tests) effectively no-ops. Two reviewers flagged this pattern.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Clarify the 'No hardcoded defaults' convention: specify whether it applies to all config types or only to connection/transport config (hosts, ports, timeouts). VisionUnitConfig now has builder defaults (modality='camera', width=640, height=480) which is ergonomic but contradicts the stated convention. Consider: 'No hardcoded defaults for connection parameters (hosts, ports, timeouts). Sensible defaults are acceptable for capability configuration types (VisionUnitConfig, MotorUnitConfig) where industry-standard values exist.'
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: VisionUnitConfig.java has hardcoded defaults added in commit 16c23b5 to support existing test expectations. CLAUDE.md says 'No hardcoded defaults: Callers must supply hosts, ports, timeouts explicitly.' One reviewer flagged the contradiction.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: When decomposing features for a milestone, group test files by compilation unit (module) rather than by logical scope. Features that modify test files in the same module have an implicit dependency because compileTestJava is module-scoped. Either: (1) assign all test fixes for a module to one feature, or (2) explicitly order features within a module and note that earlier features may complete later features' work.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: fix-motor-unit-config-tests, fix-capabilities-unit-support-tests, fix-constructor-tests all targeted sdk-core test files. The first worker fixed all of them because compileTestJava required it, making the other two features redundant no-ops.

rejectedObservations.observation: Two different patterns for equals() exist in the codebase: pattern matching instanceof vs traditional getClass() comparison. AGENTS.md doesn't specify which to use.
rejectedObservations.reason: ambiguous — Both patterns are valid for final classes in Java 17. The newer pattern matching approach is cleaner and is being consistently used in newer code. No action needed; the codebase will naturally converge on the newer pattern.

rejectedObservations.observation: NativeFeagiAgentClient.java contains ~460 em-dash Unicode characters (U+2014) in comments.
rejectedObservations.reason: already-documented — The UTF-8 encoding setting now handles these correctly. No action needed.
